description: ./init.sh creates .venv, installs the project with dev tools, lints and runs every test offline
conftest.py guard fails any test that opens a non-local network connection, proved by a test
Case loader reads JSON Lines cases and four code checkers work: exact, regex, json_schema, unittest
Targets: Python function, shell command and model (OpenAI-compatible adapter plus deterministic fake model)
Runner calls a target over the cases with parallel workers and a disk cache
Record and replay: every model call saved as a fixture keyed by SHA-256 of canonical request JSON
Statistics: mean, standard error, bootstrap CI, pass@k with CI, paired differences, kappa; checked against hand-computed reference values in tests/reference/
Judge calibration: percent agreement and Cohen's kappa with bootstrap CIs, on a fake judge first
Bias probes: answer order swap for position bias, padding for verbosity bias
Cost and latency from tokens and timings of every call, optional price table
Reports: terminal table, JSON and static HTML page
A script generates the README results table from result files and a test fails on any mismatch
Three example suites: code tasks with unit tests, JSON extraction, judge calibration with 60 or more ground-truth cases committed before the first judge run
A full example run replays from fixtures and writes byte-identical JSON twice in a row
One recorded run on a free provider exists, labeled with date, model and seed
Judge report shows agreement, kappa and both bias probes for at least one real judge model on 60+ cases
GitHub Action prints the results table as a pull request comment; a test renders the comment body to a file; actionlint passes
Part 1 section 9 quality bar: README parts in order, CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, issue templates, CI badge, topics, social preview 1280x640 from a script, static demo page, DEMO.md, link checker
Study-later kit: docs/WALKTHROUGH.md, docs/INTERVIEW_QA.md (about 15 Q&A) and DECISIONS.md
Release check (section 11): review, gitleaks full history, pip-audit, ruff S, actionlint, link check, outside check
Release candidate and hand-off (section 12): CHANGELOG rc1 with SHA, docs/HUMAN_STEPS.md, docs/handoff/COWORK_PROMPT.md
